watchlistQuery._comment: The watchlist is swept through Google News in groups, so a deal at any tracked house surfaces even when no trade outlet has covered it yet.
watchlistQuery.terms: (acquire OR acquires OR acquisition OR stake OR merger OR IPO OR funding OR investment OR earnings OR results OR guidance OR partnership OR licence OR license OR divest OR sells OR sale) when:1d
